description: Per-worktree slot (md5 of the repo root, mod 50) and the port map derived from it. ONE definition in scripts/lib/slot.mjs; every other consumer imports it or shells out to its CLI. Registered for the scan block, not to permit a duplicate: a slot addresses already-claimed pool devices and already-running sync servers, so a divergent copy repoints a live worktree at another's resources. scripts/lib/slot.test.mjs is listed as BOTH a copy and a lock on purpose: it holds a deliberate second implementation (legacySlot) whose only job is to assert parity.
